tasks.title: Inventory and safely absorb all non-default branches
tasks.acceptance: Every branch has an owner and unique-delta evidence; merged branches are archived or deleted only after approval.

tasks.title: Apply the five-lane branch ruleset
tasks.acceptance: Main and five integration lanes are protected; short-lived branches squash-merge and auto-delete.

tasks.title: Consolidate GitHub Actions into one required CI entry point
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate triggers are removed and one required workflow fans out by changed path.

tasks.title: Establish one canonical solution and build graph
tasks.acceptance: All supported C#, F#, C++, Python, and WinUI projects are mapped, buildable, and owned.

tasks.title: Quarantine generated and historical repository clutter
tasks.acceptance: Root completion reports and binaries have a reviewed keep, archive, or remove decision and generated output is ignored.

tasks.title: Run secret, binary, dependency, and privileged-action audit
tasks.acceptance: Findings are triaged without exposing secrets and dangerous automation defaults to dry-run with rollback gates.

tasks.title: Make polyglot CI deterministic
tasks.acceptance: Pinned toolchains build and test C#, F#, C++, Python, and WinUI in appropriate Linux and Windows lanes.

tasks.title: Unify Hermes, XCore, and AIHub contracts
tasks.acceptance: One versioned event envelope preserves correlation IDs, evidence links, evaluation, and pruning decisions.

tasks.title: Reconcile helios-control with the canonical platform
tasks.acceptance: Overlapping control modules are replaced by explicit packages, adapters, or tracked migrations.

tasks.title: Audit hermes-fleet-production integration boundaries
tasks.acceptance: Fleet ownership, APIs, events, version compatibility, and failure isolation are documented and contract-tested.

tasks.title: Complete workload-identity Azure bootstrap
tasks.acceptance: Azure CLI setup uses OIDC, Key Vault, least privilege, protected environments, and Bicep what-if; no credentials are committed.

tasks.title: Select and validate the canonical WinUI 3 shell
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate UI prototypes are retired after accessibility, packaging, startup, and smoke-test comparison.

tasks.title: Create measured native performance boundaries
tasks.acceptance: C++ is used only behind benchmarked, memory-safe interop boundaries with C# fallback and regression budgets.

tasks.title: Validate F# analytics and Python prediction pipelines
tasks.acceptance: Typed schemas, reproducible datasets, deterministic tests, and model-quality thresholds cover both runtimes.

tasks.title: Automate backlog, release, and repository hygiene
tasks.acceptance: Idempotent automation labels work, closes stale duplicates safely, generates releases, and reports drift without direct production mutation.
